source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; stay beside your carry and answer their engage instead of throwing Web Lash first.
support.issue: names Narbash, who is not in this lane's matchup list
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat this lane; stay beside your carry and answer their engage instead of throwing Web Lash first.

offlane.quote: Open with Boreal Sweep to slow, then Glacial Charge in and Hoarfrost to root, and keep hitting to trigger the Frost Storm. Once Crescelia is done around minute 14, follow the root with Cryoseism so the stun and explosion land together.
offlane.issue: Cryoseism explodes after its stun, not together with it
offlane.rewrite: Open with Boreal Sweep to slow, then Glacial Charge in and Hoarfrost to root, and keep hitting to trigger the Frost Storm. Once Crescelia is done around minute 14, follow the root with Cryoseism so its slow and stun hold them until it explodes.

support.quote: Dekker wins this lane; wait for her to use her stun before you charge in.
support.issue: Dekker is an even matchup, not a losing one
support.rewrite: Dekker trades evenly with you; wait for her to use her stun before you charge in.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; let them engage first and answer with Cursed Edge instead of leaping in.
support.issue: names Narbash, who is not in this lane's matchup list
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat this lane; let them engage first and answer with Cursed Edge instead of leaping in.

jungle.quote: Gank with Forward Crunch, then empowered Right Crunch to knock them up and Left Crunch, weaving basic attacks between abilities. Once Spear Of Desolation lands around minute 15, use Re-Crunch to repeat the knock-up or the true-damage swing.
jungle.issue: Right Crunch is not empowered as the second ability; Turbo Crunch needs 2 Turbo stacks first
jungle.rewrite: Gank with Forward Crunch and Left Crunch to build Turbo, then spend Turbo Crunch on Right Crunch to knock them up, weaving basic attacks between abilities. Once Spear Of Desolation lands around minute 15, use Re-Crunch to repeat your last ability.

jungle.quote: If Judgement of the Heavens misses, keep Surge of the Heavens to get out instead of face-tanking the whole enemy team.
jungle.issue: jargon 'face-tanking' a new player may not know
jungle.rewrite: If Judgement of the Heavens misses, keep Surge of the Heavens to get out instead of standing in front of the whole enemy team and soaking their damage.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; stay behind your carry and save Maco Strike! to stop their engage.
support.issue: Narbash is not in this lane's matchup list; Phase (theirs) is omitted
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this lane on our read; stay behind your carry and save Maco Strike! to stop their engage.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; don't charge Serenity in the open, stay behind your carry with Alacrity ready.
support.issue: Narbash is not in this lane's matchup list; Phase (theirs) is omitted
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this lane on our read; don't charge Serenity in the open, stay behind your carry with Alacrity ready.

carry.quote: Hit your target with Scar so the stacks root them, fire Obliterate so the missiles focus them, then finish with the last round of Fate, which always crits. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, use Reckoning to pull a carry out of the fight.
carry.issue: source never says the final round always crits; it deals bonus missing-health damage
carry.rewrite: Hit your target with Scar so the stacks root them, fire Obliterate so the missiles focus them, then finish with the last round of Fate, which deals bonus damage based on their missing health. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, use Reckoning to pull a carry out of the fight.

midlane.quote: Throw Scar on the target to set up the root, follow with Obliterate, then land Fate's final crit round, fighting only when your reload is done. After Plasma Blade and Deathstalker, roam and pull isolated targets into the Nether Realm with Reckoning.
midlane.issue: calls the final round a guaranteed crit; source only gives it bonus missing-health damage
midlane.rewrite: Throw Scar on the target to set up the root, follow with Obliterate, then land Fate's final round for its bonus damage on wounded targets, fighting only when your reload is done. After Plasma Blade and Deathstalker, roam and pull isolated targets into the Nether Realm with Reckoning.

jungle.quote: Gank from fog with Riplash to pull the target, Shock Therapy to silence them, then Electrocute for the shield while you basic attack. Once Orion and Prophecy are done, look for Skewer to lock down several enemies at an objective.
jungle.issue: 'from fog' is jargon a new player may not know
jungle.rewrite: Gank from out of sight with Riplash to pull the target, Shock Therapy to silence them, then Electrocute for the shield while you basic attack. Once Orion and Prophecy are done, look for Skewer to lock down several enemies at an objective.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and stay behind your carry until your jungler arrives.
support.issue: names Narbash, who is not in this lane's matchup list, and omits Phase (a 'theirs' verdict)
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Phase win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and stay behind your carry until your jungler arrives.

offlane.quote: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, then back off between trades instead of trading health. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.
offlane.issue: 'back off between trades instead of trading health' is self-contradictory wording
offlane.rewrite: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, then back off before they can hit you back. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.
